conclusion: streaming validation gap confirmed; native framing origin unresolved
observations: The first native generation emits a valid save_memory call; the tool persists Imani. Its private continuation state is carried into the next request.

The final native output contains duplicate greetings separated by an unmatched closing reasoning delimiter. Text emissions show the delimiter reached the streaming sink before ReasoningOutput.clean threw invalidResponse.

MLXReasoningChannel uses ReasoningEventEmitter. Outside a reasoning span, that scanner watches only the opening delimiter, so unmatched closing delimiters are forwarded as response text. ConversationToolLoop validates the accumulated response only after delivery.
The next two turns also fail late validation, and their generated text echoes the interrupted-reply history annotation. The recall-only second turn additionally executes save_memory.

The installed LFM template appends an open thinking span to generation prompts. LocalTokenizer decodes special tokens for prompt-tail priming. The LFM standard tool decoder does not separately route private spans, ruling out a deliberate two-layer reasoning filter in this path.

For completed generations without tool calls, MLXGenerationCollector intentionally omits reasoningContent. An archived outputReasoningBytes value of zero therefore does not prove that no private tokens were generated.

A tokenizer-only inspection of the exact third-turn request reproduces all 1336 recorded input tokens and the expected open thinking prefix. That rules out a missing generation prefix for the inspected request; no native generation replay has been substituted for it.
limits: The archive does not retain raw generated tokens. Tokenizer inspection establishes correct generation-prefix rendering for the third turn, while stream receipts establish malformed markers and late rejection. The native origin of the extra closing markers remains unresolved. No private-channel trace is published and no repair/replay replaces the failed receipt.

ConversationContextManager targets 2731 total tokens with five tools versus 3968 with none. limits: Do not infer a native context-limit failure, a wrong summary, or three independent model failures from this timeout. The missing progress checkpoint is an evaluation observability limitation; a separate instrumented replay is needed for stage attribution.
